```
POST /v1/embeddings 403 Forbidden
{"error":"invalid_api_key","detail":"external_id mismatch"}
```

morgan_sales: pausing renewal reminders now. If unresolved >3h, approve 2-week credit.

lee_support: ops-bot: request tenant-sync for nimbus-42 external_id=nimbus-ext-42
ops-bot: request INF-6042 logged and assigned to devin_eng.
devin_eng: applied mapping and purged cache. running verification.

anya_cs: sending external note now: "We're aware of an ingestion issue after a key rotation. Engineers applied a fix and service is restored. We'll follow up with details and a goodwill credit if needed."
morgan_sales: billing note queued; looping finance/legal for the credit. owners: ENG=devin_eng, SUPPORT=lee_support, CS=anya_cs, SALES=morgan_sales.
